Ollama provider sends the embedding to /api/embed and maps the native reply

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.embed_async(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: ['Hello', 'World'], model: 'ollama/all-minilm'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.model.inspect
puts result.usage.prompt_tokens.inspect
```
